name: Thief Story
source:
Visual novel about the guy who "worked" as a thief,
this time he has something mysterious as a target...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180117212138/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE196106]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一部讲述小偷的视觉小说。这名男子曾以小偷为业，而这一次，他盯上的目标似乎有些神秘……

（来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180117212138/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE196106]DLsite[/url]）
